image_description: A close-up, eye-level shot of a small turtle, likely a mud or musk turtle, situated in grassy, earthy terrain. The turtle has a dark, high-domed carapace with visible scutes and some algae or dirt accumulation. Its head is extended, showing a pointed snout, small lateral eye, and yellowish-green skin on the neck and jaw. One front limb is visible, appearing stout with claws. The background consists of blurred green grass and brown soil.
